sample.Description: 0-based sample index in the recording (= source_value - 1)

Levels.stimulus_marker: Stimulus marker stored by the authors in mark_tmr. The release does not label which stimulus (item, cued/uncued) each marker belongs to.

source_variable.Description: MATLAB variable in the source .mat holding the marker

source_value.Description: Marker value exactly as stored (MATLAB 1-based sample index into Raw_ieeg_data_tmr); onset = (source_value - 1) / 512 s

marker_number.Description: Order of the marker in the source vector
